title: MSFS Marketplace Update: 4 new airports + massive scenery drop! (PC Only)
description:
This week’s Marketplace Update brings a fresh batch of exciting new airports and gorgeous scenery additions to Microsoft Flight Simulator (PC) as of February 21, 2026. If you're looking to expand your world with must‑have locations and enhanced visuals, this week delivers some fantastic picks for sim pilots!

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 Dr Zewiecki Design: EPKT Katowice Airport (Beautifully detailed regional Polish hub)
🛫 Dr Zewiecki Design: EPRA Radom Airport (Newly enhanced Polish military‑civil airport)
🛫 Fly 2 High: KHVN New Haven Airport (Great for East Coast regional ops)
🛫 msfscenerybuilders: KVGT North Las Vegas Airport (Perfect for scenic desert flying)

🌆 New sceneries added this week (PC)
The following sceneries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🌆 Enhanced Road Lights (multiple cities)
These packages improve night lighting, road illumination, and overall visibility across a large set of cities and regions. All of the following are part of the same “Enhanced Road Lights” series:
Amsterdam, Annapolis, Atlantic City, Auckland, Austin, Baltimore, Barcelona, Baton Rouge, Beirut, Birmingham, Bogota, Bratislava, Canberra, Charlotte, Chicago, Cincinnati, Cleveland, Colorado, Columbia, Columbus, Dallas‑Fort Worth, Denver, Des Moines, Oklahoma, Panama City, Richmond, Riga, Salem, Santa Fe, Shanghai, Sofia, Topeka
🌳 Real Trees (multiple cities)
These focus on improving vegetation quality and realism:
Detroit, Louisville, Memphis, New Orleans, Tulsa
🌆 Region Enhanced (non‑lighting)
These offer area‑wide enhancements beyond lighting alone:
Mexico City Region Enhanced
Montpelier Region Enhanced

If you enjoy these updates, feel free to like the video, subscribe to the channel, and drop your thoughts in the comments—I'd love to hear what you’re flying this week!

Thanks for watching, and ✈️ See you in the skies!
